condition: inert install has trace, no root links, hidden record, readable withheld state, and approved whole tree
calls_per_judgment: at most one; none during rollback
measurement_scope: verified inert install path; count child separately from its own descendants

condition: the closure holds at least one spec; again for each page while an answer carries next_page_token

condition: the batch named an advisory whose record is not kept under its id and modified
measurement_scope: e2e record rows; the cost fixture names no advisory

condition: catalog is stale or missing, or its file holds no catalog, when a closure with a package is judged
calls_per_judgment: one per closure, whether the refresh succeeds or fails
measurement_scope: warm and cold-loopback whole-post cost fixture; failure condition is separate

condition: install record reaches binary check; selected entry is a regular file or resolves to one
calls_per_judgment: first20 new names, then Bash IFS splitting; one call for each resulting existing file
